issue_request: FHIR-18401 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-I change request asking for a flyover on the Extension Registry letter M because the registry did not define that M meant modifier extension.
initial_application: The request was applied by core commit db9355a66d9e549d3043a73c6aef8c9f6e40b46b, which changed the then-current extension registry generator to render M with title="This is a modifier extension". The Jira snapshot also includes a 2018-11-08 editor comment saying the request was already done.
additional_context: The old core source/extensibility-registry.html page was deleted in 2023 when registry content moved to the extensions IG, and publish.ini now leaves extensibility-registry.html commented out of the core build. Current core navigation and narrative link to [%extensions-location%]extension-registry.html. The FHIR Extension Pack defines extension-registry.html as a markdown-generated page and its registry legend says the Card. column includes the letter M if the extension is a modifier extension.
reconciliation: No FHIR core source change was made. The current core checkout no longer owns an authoritative registry page, and the current authoritative Extension Pack source already satisfies the seed issue by explaining the M marker.
